features: Neutral teal/blue login controls, SVG theme buttons, restrained logo-only sheen, padded field icons, shared local English type, opt-in browser password-manager save and remember control.
Load shell styles before first paint; preload the local refraction map; remove scroll-wide animation freezing.
Flat inner user/support detail surfaces, persistent outer liquid glass, stronger refraction and subtle colored edges; keep glass blur at 6px.
Consistent neutral Delete/Reset light icons, identical header-control geometry, opener hidden while mobile menu is open and slightly stronger menu icons.
Compact profile usage, horizontal Devices/Wallet shortcuts, icon-only header shortcuts with accessible labels, full-width private-link regeneration and no black submit bar.
Theme-aware settings/OpenVPN buttons and callouts with wrapped mobile layout; bright avatar-derived complements; overflow-safe large usage/device metrics and small first-use labels.
Simple customer/partner backdrops with 5% tint, a faint tint in the white admin background, and restored blue Telegram card.
Prime-style action states and real-byte download progress adapted from the supplied React examples into the existing native app; no synthetic progress or dependency runtime.
Wallet styling aligned with partner dashboard; Add funds and mobile shortcuts reuse header controls.

Renewal-page AJAX wallet payment with small balance label, server-side plan/custom pricing and discount validation, atomic conditional debit, duplicate-submit protection and refreshed account/balance display without reload.
Roll back uncommitted approval failures, while reporting committed payments with pending node confirmation as successful.
Smaller red notification count without border/shadow; restore nearly opaque theme-aware notification popup for readable text.

validation.rendered_pages: 44 EN/FA Flask SSR pages plus login, wallet, customer-background and profile structural checks.
validation.frontend: Node VM action-state/download tests (real byte progress, HTTP failure), and mocked-WebGL theme/lifecycle tests.
validation.finance: Wallet debit/invoice, duplicate submission, insufficient funds, bad CSRF, rollback before commit, and post-commit node-sync failure; existing commerce and representative catalog tests.
validation.source: Python/Jinja/JS/CSS/Bash parsing, 43 local script integrity pins, installer preflight, ZIP CRC and per-file hashes.

limitations: Actual mobile/desktop browser appearance and live VPS deployment were not verified in this environment.
Browser password-manager saving depends on browser support and user consent; no passwords are stored in localStorage.
Wallet payment pays the full plan amount; split wallet/bank payments are not implemented.
Download completion means the response was received and handed to the browser save flow, not confirmation of a file on disk.
No VPN core, session guard or network policy changes.
